attacksRun.attack: the subject omits DR-117's other leftover-design remainders — D-157 records that EE-7a, EE-7b and EE-7d remain leftover-design, yet the subject's leftoverDesign set names only OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING
attacksRun.detail: Raised as a candidate blocker because a leftover set that silently drops live leftovers would be the most consequential failure available here. D-157's own words defeat it: 'It owns DR-117 EE-1, EE-2, EE-3b, EE-4, EE-5a, EE-5b, and EE-6a only', and separately 'EE-7a, EE-7b, and EE-7d remain leftover-design. EE-6b, EE-7c, and EE-7e remain capable-of-riding and unnamed at G09/G14/G16.' Those remainders are therefore not G29's to carry, and a G29 gate leftover-join that listed them would be claiming scope D-157 expressly withheld. The subject is scoped correctly throughout: leftoverDesignOpenStanding speaks only of G29 initial states and G29 fixture implementations, and nothing in the artifact asserts that DR-117's leftover-design is exhausted — it repeats 'does not SATISFY DR-117' five times.

It is not a drop: the string appears twice in COORD and zero times in g29-leftover-join v1, v2, v3 and the harness specification alike. No artifact in this lineage has ever carried it, so v3 removed nothing. The advisory travels on D-157 as honesty work owed on a successor of D-157's own subject, not on the leftover-join lineage that measures the gate's remainder.

Any reviewer carrying an assumption across the two lineages would be wrong in one direction. The subject avoids the trap by saying nothing about either.

A reader who takes this artifact's single-member leftoverDesign set as the state of DR-117 as a whole would be misreading it; the set is scoped to G29, which D-157 limited to seven EE classes 'only'.

The live DR-G29 evidence cell names two gate boundaries, G21 and G23, while the subject disclaims four. The extra two, G24 and G30, come from the pinned harness rather than the register cell. Noted because a reader checking the disclaimer against file 08 alone will not find G24 or G30 there.

decision: ACCEPT — 0 blockers, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Seventeen attacks run, all refuted against live bytes, including three candidate findings raised and defeated: an unnamed-EE-remainder gap killed by D-157's own 'owns ... only' limitation, an unpropagated D-157 advisory killed by showing no lineage artifact ever carried it, and a reduced section-7.1 occurrence count killed by showing both versions carry identical fourteen-entry doesNot lists. The subject is unmoved at 4ab44cae... mode 0444. Twenty-two digest checks pass with zero mismatches and no cross-citation conflict. recordedInputs.HEAD, the top-level head and live HEAD are identical, and HEAD is confirmed to be the D-203 adoption commit. The DR-G29 live row reproduces exactly, including its single-owner 'Product owner' cell, and the harness's liveHarnessCellVerbatim matches the live cell character for character. The seven-class EE list is exactly D-157's, the four-gate boundary is grounded in the pinned harness, and the subject is correctly silent on gates 2 and 3, which stand opposite here to the adjacent DR-131 lineage. The leftoverDesign set is exactly ['OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING'], unchanged across v1, v2 and v3, the six-member partition is exact, required-now stays 28, and nothing is SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, sealed, or authorized.
